name: 39170 · Terry, MS
findings: ZIP 39170 (Terry) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39170 (Terry) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 39170 (Terry) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
